PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # input pair width (um), L=0.15
    "W_tail": (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # clocked tail switch
    "W_ln":   (1.5, 0.6, 4.0),    # latch NMOS
    "W_lp":   (2.0, 0.6, 6.0),    # latch PMOS
    "W_rst":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # reset PMOS switches
    "W_on":   (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter NMOS
    "W_op":   (2.5, 0.84, 8.0),   # output inverter PMOS
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_tail"], L)
    # input pair: vinp -> node P, vinn -> node Q
    n.M("M1", "P", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    n.M("M2", "Q", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch: X over P, Y over Q
    n.M("M3", "X", "Y", "P", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "Y", "X", "Q", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "X", "Y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "Y", "X", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low = reset to VDD)
    n.M("R1", "P", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("R2", "Q", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("R3", "X", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("R4", "Y", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    # output inverters: vinp>vinn -> X falls -> outp high
    n.M("MIpn", "outp", "X", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_on"], L)
    n.M("MIpp", "outp", "X", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_op"], L)
    n.M("MInn", "outn", "Y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_on"], L)
    n.M("MInp", "outn", "Y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_op"], L)

    # ---- first-order predictions (worst case ss/125C) ----
    Cox_area = 8.5e-15            # F/um^2 approx
    Cov = 0.35e-15                # F/um overlap+junction approx
    def cg(W): return W * L * Cox_area + 2 * Cov * W
    def cj(W): return 1.0e-15 * W

    try:
        lw = lut.at("ss", 125)
        on = lw.op("n", p["W_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
        op_ = lw.op("p", p["W_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
        gm_l = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
        oi = lw.op("n", p["W_in"], L, 0.9 - 0.15, 0.6)
        i_tail = 2 * oi["Id"]
    except Exception:
        gm_l = 2.5e-4 * (p["W_ln"] / 1.5)
        i_tail = 3e-4 * p["W_in"] / 3.0

    Cx = cj(p["W_ln"]) + cj(p["W_lp"]) + cj(p["W_rst"]) + cg(p["W_ln"]) + cg(p["W_lp"]) \
         + cg(p["W_on"]) + cg(p["W_op"])
    Cp = cj(p["W_in"]) + cj(p["W_ln"]) + cj(p["W_rst"])
    # integration phase: discharge P/Q then X/Y by ~Vthn
    t_int = (Cp + Cx) * 0.7 / max(i_tail / 2, 1e-6)
    av = max(gm_l * t_int / max(Cx, 1e-16), 2.0)
    t_regen = Cx / max(gm_l, 1e-6) * math.log(max(vdd / (av * dv), 1.5))
    t_inv = 0.69 * cl * 2.0 / max(1e-4 * p["W_op"], 1e-6)
    delay = t_int + t_regen + t_inv

    vmax = 1.98
    C_sw = 2 * Cx + 2 * Cp + cj(p["W_tail"]) + cl + 2 * cj(p["W_op"]) \
           + cg(p["W_tail"]) + 4 * cg(p["W_rst"])          # clock-driven gates
    energy = C_sw * vmax ** 2

    return n, {"delay": delay, "energy": energy, "correct": 1}
